newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Auto picks Jacksonvile, Fla., as unit's base.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Auto picks Jacksonvile, Fla., as unit's base.

text.p: National Auto Finance Co Inc said Monday it has selected Jacksonville, Fla., to be the site for its loan servicing divisional headquarters.
It said it will invest about $4.4 million as capital for the division over the next five years, exclusive of general operating expenses.
It said the unit's offices will include customer service, collections and operational accounting activities, many of which were previously outsourced.
